sources.title: Synthetic evaluation fixture: trial A
sources.abstract: In a synthetic randomized trial of 100 adults, intervention A reduced symptom score by 3 points versus placebo after 8 weeks (95% CI 1 to 5 points lower).

sources.title: Synthetic evaluation fixture: trial B
sources.abstract: In a separate synthetic randomized trial of 120 adults, intervention A differed from placebo by 0.1 symptom-score points after 8 weeks (95% CI -1.0 to 1.2). There was no statistically clear difference. No pooled analysis was performed.

chunks.text: In a synthetic randomized trial of 100 adults, intervention A reduced symptom score by 3 points versus placebo after 8 weeks (95% CI 1 to 5 points lower).

In a separate synthetic randomized trial of 120 adults, intervention A differed from placebo by 0.1 symptom-score points after 8 weeks (95% CI -1.0 to 1.2). There was no statistically clear difference. No pooled analysis was performed.
